note: Iowa DNR campground on Gull Point, on the west shore of West Okoboji Lake (Iowa Great Lakes). The loops sit in shaded woods in the middle of the point, away from the lake; the swim beach, boat access and the CCC-era lodge are elsewhere in the park. No daily park-entry fee in Iowa. --Claude
summary: Hookups (30A, no sewer), 111 sites to 45 ft (no pull-throughs), facilities, season Apr 15-Oct 31 and booking (100% reservable, 3-month window, 10 pm day-of cutoff) confirmed from DNR/ReserveAmerica; stored 'up to ~40 ft' corrected to 45. Not waterfront confirmed (woods; only a small pond). Fees unchanged (match RA 2027 rates). Pin fine. Note trimmed.
flags: WATERFRONT: not waterfront confirmed. ReserveAmerica tags all 112 sites 'Near Water - no'; the campground is under canopy mid-point with West Okoboji ~280 m east past woods and private lakeshore homes. The only water by any site is the small marshy pond (roughly 0.5-1.5 ha on imagery, under the 5-acre pond line) at the SE corner by sites 56-59/65, which earns nothing under the pond rule.
FIT: 44 of 112 sites are listed for 15-20 ft equipment only; 68 take 25-45 ft, including 20 non-electric sites, so the $10/$14 non-electric base stands.
PIN: stored 43.37100,-95.16680 is at the SE edge of the loops (~100 m from their centre); DNR's directions point is 43.371485,-95.167755. No change needed.
